# HttpProtect.textMiddleware() method

A middleware that rejects with `text/plain`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
textMiddleware(): (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => Promise<void>;
```
**Returns:**

(req: Request, res: [Response](/api/http-protect/latest/http-protect.response/)<!-- -->, next: [NextFunction](/api/http-protect/latest/http-protect.nextfunction/)<!-- -->) =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;

An async middleware to hand to `app.use()`<!-- -->.

## Remarks

Sends the code and its reason phrase — `429 Too Many Requests`<!-- -->, or `418 I'm a teapot` for a ban. Sets `Content-Type` through [Response.header()](/api/http-protect/latest/http-protect.response.header/) if the framework has it, [Response.setHeader()](/api/http-protect/latest/http-protect.response.setheader/) otherwise, and omits it if neither exists.
